title: Diabetes definition and three pillars
sec: Diabetes definition and three pillars · p917
guide: Anchor the three pillars (FPG ≥126, 2-h PG ≥200, HbA1c ≥6.5%) and pre-diabetes ranges. Asymptomatic diagnosis requires repeat testing; oral glucose tolerance test detects IGT earlier than fasting glucose.

title: Ominous octet and pathophysiology of T2DM
sec: Ominous octet and pathophysiology of T2DM · p918
guide: Map the eight defects: pancreas (β/α), liver (gluconeogenesis), muscle (GLUT4), fat (lipolysis), brain, gut (incretin), kidney (SGLT2). Note the schematic's 'CPT-1 absent in liver' is biologically inaccurate; insulin normally suppresses HSL in adipocytes.

title: Dirty dozen, classification, diagnostics
guide: Distinguish Type 1, Type 2, gestational and other specific types. MODY 3 (HNF1A) is sulfonylurea-responsive; MODY 2 (GCK) is mild and rarely treated; autoimmune screening uses GAD, IA-2 and ZnT8.

title: Pre-DM treatment, screening, HbA1c targets
sec: Pre-DM treatment, screening, HbA1c targets · p920
guide: Lifestyle (7% weight loss, 150 min/week) is first-line; metformin is added for high-risk patients; metformin is contraindicated at eGFR <30. Most adults aim HbA1c <7%, elderly 7.5–8%, pregnancy <6.5%.

title: Classification: LADA, type 3c, type 4, monogenic
sec: Classification: LADA, type 3c, type 4, monogenic · p921
guide: LADA is slow autoimmune diabetes in non-obese adults; Type 3c is pancreatogenic; GDM is pregnancy-onset. Wolfram syndrome (DIDMOAD) and mitochondrial diabetes (MELAS-related) are rare monogenic forms.

title: Type 2 history, metabolic syndrome, BMI
sec: Type 2 history, metabolic syndrome, BMI · p922
guide: South Asians face higher diabetes risk at lower BMIs (overweight ≥23, obese ≥25). Metabolic syndrome combines waist, BP, TG, HDL and fasting glucose criteria; insulin, sulfonylureas, metformin and GLP-1 agonists each mark a discovery milestone.

title: T1DM markers, autoimmunity and antibody interpretation
sec: T1DM markers, autoimmunity and antibody interpretation · p923
guide: GAD, IA-2 and ZnT8 are the principal autoantibodies; ZnT8 positivity exceeds 95% in some populations. C-peptide measures endogenous insulin; insulin level is confounded by exogenous insulin. HLA-DR3/DR4 increase T1DM risk.

title: Insulin-resistance syndromes, MODY, type 4
guide: Type A insulin-resistance is genetic (INSR), Type B is autoimmune. HAIR-AN combines hyperandrogenism, IR and acanthosis; Donohue and Rabson-Mendenhall are severe receptor mutations. KCNJ11 and ABCC8 mutations cause sulfonylurea-responsive neonatal diabetes.

title: Pancreatic and drug-induced diabetes algorithm
sec: Pancreatic and drug-induced diabetes algorithm · p925
guide: Chronic pancreatitis causes most type 3c diabetes; pancreatic cancer can present with new-onset diabetes. Glucocorticoids, tacrolimus, antipsychotics and pentamidine are notable diabetogenic drugs. Note the algorithm's arrow scheme appears inverted vs the C-peptide table on p928.

title: Diabetes associations and review
guide: Haemochromatosis causes 'bronze diabetes'; Cushing, acromegaly and pheochromocytoma are endocrine causes of secondary diabetes. Glucagonoma presents with necrolytic migratory erythema and diabetes; VIPoma causes WDHA.
